items.headline: Claude Haiku 5.5 launches as Anthropic's cheapest, fastest model
items.summary: Anthropic released Haiku 5.5, its small, low-cost model, on October 7. It costs about 75% less than the previous Haiku, and it adds an adjustable effort setting so you can trade cost against thinking depth. Max and Team plans also get a new monthly API credit.
items.why_it_matters: If you use Claude through automations or apps that call it behind the scenes (the API), this makes quick jobs like summaries, sorting and customer replies much cheaper.

opportunity.action_note: Check your Claude Max plan settings for the new monthly API credit and use it to test Haiku 5.5 in one automation this week.
